Alex  thanks for the quick follow-up and the questionnaire. Wanted to respond with what we can provide right away and outline Redwood's vulnerability management posture so you have concrete SLAs to evaluate.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). We can share the full report under a mutual NDA; the executive summary and attestations are included in the attached security overview.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA workloads via a BAA and have GDPR data processing agreements available. We can share templates with your legal/security teams.
- Pen test: We can provide an executive summary immediately and arrange delivery of a redacted full report under NDA. The latest third-party pen test executive summary (Q4 2025) is attached: PenTest-Redwood-Executive-Summary-202510.pdf.

Vulnerability management (high level):
- External scanning cadence: weekly unauthenticated scans + monthly authenticated scanning for web-facing services.
- Internal testing: quarterly internal scans and annual 3rd-party pen test (supplemented by targeted tests post-major releases).
- Triage & SLA: critical (CVSS 9-10)  initial triage within 24 hours, mitigation or compensating controls within 7 calendar days; high (CVSS 7-8.9)  triage within 48 hours, remediation targeted within 30 days; medium/low  prioritized in backlog and tracked to completion per release cycles.
- Disclosure: We follow coordinated disclosure practices. For externally discovered issues we have a reporter intake process and aim to acknowledge reports within 48 hours. We will coordinate any public disclosure with affected customers.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll have our security PM (Neha) work through your questionnaire  we should be able to return the completed spreadsheet within 3 business days.
2) If you confirm NDA requirements, we can share the full SOC 2 report and the full pen test under NDA (legal can push the NDA to your counsel).
3) If an executive summary + completed questionnaire is acceptable for initial procurement review, we'll get those to you by EOD Thursday.

Let us know which path you prefer.


